email.subject: Quick fix for Honey Hair Studio's site
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I looked at Honey Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no mobile-friendly layout (most salon searches happen on phones, so visitors on their phone may leave before seeing your photos or number), and no hours listed anywhere (people checking if you're open now have no way to tell, and often just call a competitor instead). The site also has no online booking, so anyone browsing after hours can't reserve a spot.

I fix this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change — no obligation either way.

Alex
